outside_window.finding: Q3 / 9M 2026 results, board on 2026-11-16. The guide implies H2 revenue of EUR 303.5-353.5m against H1's EUR 396.5m, so revenue running at or above the top of the range is plausible (Equita expects the top end). But the ~11% FY adj. EBITDA margin needs about 13% in H2 against 9.9% in Q2 and 9.1% in H1, so the margin leg of the guide is the one at risk. NFP rose to EUR 280.1m on a working-capital build (trade NWC EUR 274.9m vs EUR 207.4m), which tests the positive operating cash flow guide. Sign unresolved, so sized at 0 here.
